route.performance_mode: runtime default for the fail-closed baseline; optional burst must be a separate measured route
route.soc_model: runtime auto-detect on the physical phone; host context generation used pinned model 43

contract.source: Exact experiment-0018 model assets/Junhao voice/seed 20260818 with canonical-v2 transcript SHA 424b3807…db67 and its direct 51-ID SentencePiece output; legacy-v1 text evidence is preserved separately

disclosed_cpu_work: Precomputed SentencePiece token IDs and prompt-row assembly
Extraction of appended K/V at output index 600 and copy to logical valid-length state slot
PCM16 WAV encoding and evidence hashing

runs.benchmark: Matched CPU and all-HTP routes each use a fresh profiling-off process, four session creations, one first generation and five warm generations; all four sessions are reused and full generation state is reset before every run
runs.provider_physical_evidence: Separate fresh detailed-profile process per route, one generation each; HTP requires ORT provider plus QNN physical evidence

measurements.rtf: End-to-end run time divided by actual emitted WAV duration
measurements.setup: Four-session creation time, both aggregate and per component
measurements.first_audio: Run start through complete fixed-capacity audio-tokenizer decode; first PCM then exists in memory. This is non-streaming.
measurements.memory: Whole-process VmHWM plus sampled VmRSS and PSS; not isolated model allocations
measurements.thermal: dumpsys thermalservice immediately before and after each process
measurements.power: dumpsys battery immediately before and after each process
measurements.profiling_boundary: Profile run is excluded from benchmark latency

full_htp_criteria: Every learned prefill, decode, local, and codec call is assigned only to QNNExecutionProvider with CPU fallback disabled
Every component has physical RPC execute, accelerator execute time, accelerator cycles, and four-HVX evidence
Expected provider/physical call counts match actual frame counts
WAV is finite mono PCM16 at 48 kHz with nonzero RMS and a retained SHA-256
Unique app-internal stage, exact identity gates, cleanup verification, uninstall, and lock release all pass

quality.numerical_comparison: Descriptive only; no numerical rejection threshold
quality.ultimate_gate: Moritz blind listening against accepted experiment-0018 CPU sample

forbidden_claim: A mixed fallback route or host-only context compile must never be called full HTP.
